instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete direct-booking web application with a responsive Navbar, 5-photo Airbnb hero grid, dynamic booking engine, GPay/UPI payment modal, guest review section, floating WhatsApp widget, post-booking location privacy state, and host dashboard tab/portal.
Implement accurate price calculations based on base rate ₹2400, extra guests (₹500/night for guests 3 & 4), weekend markups (15% on Fri/Sat), and last-minute discount (10% if check-in < 48 hours).
Implement down-payment logic (70% partial vs 100% full option if booking is >= 7 days away; strictly force 100% full payment if check-in is within 6 days).

Implement post-booking location privacy: display exact address as 'Hidden until host approval' on the public page, and reveal exact address and landmark once host approves in dashboard or mock approval button.
Add interactive GPay/UPI payment modal with real-time QR code rendering, reference ID field, screenshot upload simulation, and instant WhatsApp confirmation link generator.
Add a dedicated Host Dashboard route/tab with booking approval management, calendar rate overriding, date blocking/unblocking, and financial analytics.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
